deviations.claim_in_article: “Concerns about US-Iran attacks, the sea blockade, and tanker safety continued on July 14, so the flashy 20% plan left the stage”
deviations.issue: The sentence’s “so” implies that continuing security concerns caused the 20% plan to be withdrawn. The Ledger reports Trump’s stated basis as discussions with Middle Eastern leaders, but does not establish continuing security concerns as the cause of the withdrawal.
deviations.explanation: The article adds an unsupported causal link from continued security concerns to the plan’s withdrawal; the other stated facts remain consistent with the Ledger.
